authority_note: Use this file to route natural-language questions to primary domain shards, claims, and NEQs.

default_order: retrieve What We Can Say Now
retrieve What We Cannot Say Yet
retrieve supporting / limiting / adjacent HAI-SRC records
retrieval_protocol.source_use_rule: A source must be read with its domain-specific SUPPORTS and DOES_NOT_SUPPORT fields. Global source identity does not imply a single global evidentiary role.
retrieval_protocol.legal_rule: Legal instruments, case law, standards, and policy documents are not empirical proof of effectiveness.
retrieval_protocol.counterexample_rule: Counterexample domains are anti-overgeneralization routes, not oppositional verdicts.
